There are many ways to manage data more or less automatically. However, these methods are often limited by their ease of use and the fact that employees may not be able to use coding tools, which can seem confusing to them. For small- to medium-sized projects, using Excel is therefore a logical choice, as it has the advantage of being familiar to everyone.
